figurative_meaning_en: An ideal brother devoted to his elder brother
similar_in_english: A devoted sibling like Cain's keeper (biblical reference, though inverse)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার দাদার প্রতি রামের ভাই লক্ষণের মতো অনুগত।
এই ভাইটি সত্যিই রামের ভাই লক্ষণের উদাহরণ।
example_sentences_in_english: He is as devoted to his elder brother as Lakshmana was to Rama.
She praised him as the Lakshmana to her Rama in sibling loyalty.
history: This idiom originates from the Hindu epic Ramayana, where Lakshmana exemplifies unwavering devotion and loyalty to his elder brother Lord Rama, accompanying him through exile and battles.
note: Rooted in Hindu mythology, commonly used in Bengali literature and everyday speech to denote fraternal loyalty.
